status: separately versioned revision; S2 (risk_v2) is untouched and remains the reproducibility reference
semantics: elapsed-time stale detection (>= 48 h without a completed candle)
hourly risk monitoring independent of the strategy decision clock; coarser cadence refused
three valuations: last-known, conservative (drives the S2 machine), realized (closed trades plus explicit write-offs)
liquidation never assumed: impaired exposure stays visible to the machine
capital_protection_report and recovery_sensitivity expose concealed drawdown
known_limitations: monitoring requires hourly candles; other cadences are refused
a 48-hour silence is also treated as impaired for assets that are merely quiet (conservative by design)
write-off recovery assumption is a parameter, not a measurement
S2 candle-count thresholds (liquidity_alarm_candles 24) mean hours only because the monitoring clock is hourly
